exercises.emptyBody: Each exercise shows up here after your first session.

body.title: Body
body.delta_one: {{delta}} over {{weeks}} week, averaging 2 check-ins at each end.
body.delta_other: {{delta}} over {{weeks}} weeks, averaging 2 check-ins at each end.
body.profileNote: These check-ins don’t change your profile. At the end of the cycle, the review offers to use your latest weight there.
body.emptyBody: Once a week, note your weight, waist and sleep. You’ll see how they change here, and the end-of-cycle review uses them. Your profile stays as it is.
body.noneBody: Add it to your next check-in.
body.oneMore: One more check-in to see a trend.
body.chartName: {{measure}} over your check-ins. Left and right arrows move between check-ins.

tests.title: Max tests
tests.planWhen: At the end of session {{letter}} in week {{week}}, to close the cycle.
tests.planWhenWarm: Right after the warm-up of session {{letter}} in week {{week}}.
tests.unavailable: No test for now: recent pain on a similar move. Do a few pain-free sessions first.
tests.unavailableCount_one: No test for now: recent pain on a similar move. {{count}} more pain-free session first.
tests.unavailableCount_other: No test for now: recent pain on a similar move. {{count}} more pain-free sessions first.
tests.sheetBody: One set, as many clean reps as you can (or as long as you can hold). It takes under 2 minutes.

step.warmup: Warm up first if this isn’t the end of a session.
step.one: One set, no pause. Stop when a rep is no longer clean, or at 50 reps (180 s for a hold).
step.result: Your result is kept here and can move your goal up, never down.

tests.pickerNote: Push-ups, pull-ups, rows and bodyweight squats, plus four holds. Both sides at once.
tests.noMatchBody: Only exercises your equipment allows are listed.
tests.chartName: Max tests, {{name}}. Left and right arrows move between tests.
tests.emptyBody: A max test measures the most clean reps (or seconds) you can do in one set. Your programme has one at the end of week {{week}}; you can also take one now to know where you start.
tests.emptyBodyNoWeek: A max test measures the most clean reps (or seconds) you can do in one set. Take one now to know where you start.
